package com.acme.common.text;

/**
 * Masking helpers for logs and UI; never log a full NRIC, card number or e-mail.
 */
public final class StringMasks {

    private static final char MASK = '*';

    private StringMasks() {
    }

    /** Keeps the last {@code visible} characters: maskAllButLast("S1234567D", 4) -> "*****567D". */
    public static String maskAllButLast(final String value, final int visible) {
        if (value == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (visible >= value.length()) {
            return value;
        }
        final int hidden = value.length() - visible;
        return String.valueOf(MASK).repeat(hidden) + value.substring(hidden);
    }

    public static String maskEmail(final String email) {
        final int at = email.indexOf('@');
        if (at <= 1) {
            return MASK + email.substring(Math.max(at, 0));
        }
        return email.charAt(0) + String.valueOf(MASK).repeat(at - 1) + email.substring(at);
    }
}
